SELECT MENU_ID , PARENT_MENU_CD , CHILD_MENU_CD , CHILD_MENU_NM , CHILD_PAGE_ULR , CHILD_MENU_LEVEL , CHILD_MENU_SEQ , USER_YN , BTN_SEARCH_YN , BTN_SEARCH_INIT_YN , BTN_SAVE_YN , BTN_ADD_ROW_YN , BTN_DEL_ROW_YN , BTN_EXCEL_DOWN_YN , BTN_EXCEL_UP_YN , BTN_PRINT_YN , BTN_BATCH_YN , REMARK FROM BCOM.COM_MENU WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(CHILD_MENU_CD) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{menuText}) || '%' OR UPPER(CHILD_MENU_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{menuText}) || '%' )
AND USER_YN = #{userYn}
ORDER BY CHILD_MENU_SEQ, MENU_ID
